authorization: User accepted 480 normal cells plus 96 fault cells, then explicitly requested all normal cells before remaining fault cells.

all_day_fault.selection_rule: First two registered single-line cases, first registered two-line case, first registered three-line case; first three pre-existing common seeds. No algorithm ranking used to select cases.
all_day_fault.claim_boundary: Reduced representative subset of the original all-day known-outage registry, not complete coverage of the paper's 16 cases and not a full mid-run failure/reconnection experiment. Existing bounded mid-run failure/restoration tests remain separate.

native_and_metrics: All retained cells keep their exact V5 spec, runner, native method, input identity, canonical D, fixed horizon and full-population timing policy. Existing completed evidence is reused only after verification.
registry_interpretation: Original base/fault protocol files remain immutable per-cell physics and scenario registries. Their original full-matrix counts do not determine active V6 scope; this explicit sampling contract does.
